applicationChecks: Native window, private application origin, isolated settings, three public materials and sandboxed renderer
Repeated launch returns to the same application window
Embedded reader and Chinese/math PDF export work without an external browser
Window close flushes a pending edit and stops the internal service
Notes and model settings survive repeated restarts; the parent configuration remains untouched
installerChecks: Silent per-user installation succeeds in a Unicode/spaced directory; desktop and start-menu shortcuts target the installed executable
Installed binary passes native reading, PDF export, single-instance and close/restart verification
Uninstall removes the application and shortcuts while preserving user data
packageChecks: Packaged ASAR path audit: 13298 entries; no prohibited private paths
Fresh bundled materials contain exactly three public PDFs, attribution and source records
Staged application/material fingerprints recorded in PACKAGE-MANIFEST.json
Installer fingerprint agrees with verified install/uninstall report and checksum sidecar
pdfCheck: Native Electron export visually checked with Poppler: selectable Chinese text, inline/display formulas, symmetric margins and consistent paper background
limits: Unsigned Windows installer; no automatic updater
Tested same-version reinstall and ordinary uninstall; future cross-version migrations require separate validation
Existing browser/portable data is not automatically migrated
Forced termination or power loss bypasses the normal close/save flow
